Each defensive element has different effects - walls block paths, traps damage raiders, and defensive structures provide protection bonuses. Strategic placement maximizes effectiveness and creates multiple layers of defense.
category_advantages_base-defense: Strong base defense protects your investment in pets and ensures continuous income generation. Deters casual raiders and makes targeted raids more expensive. category_weaknesses_base-defense: Complex bases are expensive to build and maintain. Over-investing in defense early can slow pet collection. category_faq_base-defense_a1: Maze labyrinths are most effective but expensive. Multi-layer defense offers good balance of protection and cost. Start with compact designs for early game, upgrade to maze layouts as your pet values increase. Adapt your design to counter common raiding strategies.
category_faq_base-defense_q2: How much should I spend on defense?
category_faq_base-defense_a2: Spend 20-30% of your income on defense upgrades, scaling up as your pets become more valuable. Early game focus on basic walls, mid-game add traps, late game invest in complex layouts. Match defense investment to the value of assets you're protecting.

Each base you encounter has different defense configurations, trap placements, and pet storage layouts, so you must adapt your strategy accordingly. The raiding system rewards players who combine mechanical skill with strategic planning, making it one of the most engaging and competitive aspects of the game. Understanding raid mechanics thoroughly is essential for consistent success and progression acceleration. category_mechanics_raiding: Raiding involves infiltrating other players' bases to reach and steal their pets. Each base has different defense configurations including walls, traps, alarms, and pet storage locations. You must breach defenses using appropriate gear, avoid or disable traps, and extract pets from protected vaults. Successful raids reward you with stolen pets and cash that you can use for your own progression. Failed raids waste time and gear, so target selection and preparation are critical for efficiency. Learning common base layouts helps you plan effective raid strategies that maximize success rates and minimize risk of counter-raids against your own base. Practice and patience are essential for developing the reflexes and strategic thinking needed for consistent raid success.
category_advantages_raiding: Successful raids provide high-value pets without rolling costs, accelerating progression dramatically. Raiding teaches you about base defense by seeing how other players design their defenses, which you can apply to your own base. The skill ceiling for raiding is high, providing ongoing challenge and mastery opportunities for dedicated players. Coordinating with friends for group raids unlocks higher-difficulty targets with better rewards. Top raiders earn community recognition and can establish themselves as experts in the competitive raiding scene through consistent successful extractions and tactical coordination. Top raiders often mentor new players and contribute to community strategy guides, sharing their expertise with the broader community.
category_weaknesses_raiding: Failed raids waste gear and resources, including consumables like healing potions and temporary boost items. Strong bases can be nearly impenetrable without specific counter-gear, limiting your viable targets. The risk of counter-raid increases when you repeatedly attack the same players, potentially leading to retaliation against your own base. Server lag and connection issues can cause raid failures that are outside your control. New players may struggle against experienced defenders with optimized base designs and high-tier gear, creating a skill gap that takes time to close through practice and gear progression. Developing a successful raiding strategy requires significant practice, gear investment, and community engagement to improve consistently.
category_faq_raiding_q1: How do I choose raid targets?
category_faq_raiding_a1: Scout targets first to assess their defenses and pet values. Look for bases with high-value pets but weaker defenses. Avoid heavily fortified bases unless you have specific counter-gear. Balance risk vs reward - sometimes smaller, easier targets provide better consistent returns.
category_faq_raiding_a2: Match gear to base type - infiltration tools for mazes, advanced weapons for multi-layer defenses. Start with basic weapons, upgrade as you progress. Always carry extraction tools for faster theft. Balance gear cost with potential rewards from the target.
category_faq_raiding_a3: Target players who are inactive or have weaker defenses to minimize retaliation risk. Don't repeatedly raid the same players. Maintain strong base defense to deter counter-raids. Consider raiding during off-peak hours when target players are less likely to be online.

Many experienced players share base design patterns that you can learn to exploit during raids. Spend a few minutes observing the target base rather than rushing in, as preparation dramatically increases your success rate. Identify the most valuable pet in the base and plan your route to reach it efficiently while avoiding the heaviest defenses.
category_qt_raiding_1: Carry backup gear and consumables in case your first attempt fails. Healing potions, shield items, and emergency escape tools can save a raid that goes wrong. Test your gear loadout in practice scenarios before attempting high-stakes raids against experienced defenders. Have a backup plan for each phase of the raid, including contingencies for when traps trigger or alarms go off. Practice different raid styles to develop versatility for various base designs and defense configurations.
category_qt_raiding_2: Join a raiding community or Discord channel to find experienced partners for coordinated group raids. Group raids unlock harder targets with better rewards and provide backup when your raid goes wrong. Many experienced raiders are willing to mentor newer players who show dedication and skill. Coordinate your team composition to cover each role: breachers, scouts, extractors, and lookouts. Practice team coordination in casual raids before attempting high-stakes group content together with your team members.

From beginner tutorials to advanced strategies, our category hub organizes every guide, code list, and gameplay tip into clearly defined sections. Whether you are looking for active codes, pet rolling strategies, base defense tactics, or raid planning, our categories help you find the right information quickly and efficiently. Each category contains in-depth articles, frequently asked questions, quick tips, and current game data to support your Build a Base and Steal journey. category_qt_codes: Follow the official Discord server and bookmark the codes page to receive instant notifications when new codes are released. Set up alerts on Twitter for the developer's account. New codes typically drop during special events, update launches, and player milestone celebrations. Verification on official sources prevents time wasted on fake codes that scammers circulate on unofficial sites, and the wiki verifies every code before adding it to the list. Checking daily takes less than a minute and can save you hours of farming time.

Redeem codes immediately as they expire quickly, often within 1-2 weeks of release. Prioritize the highest-value codes first if you can only redeem a few per session. Some codes have limited redemption windows, so claim them as soon as you see them in the official channels. Set a daily reminder to check for new codes so you never miss a release.

Codes are case-sensitive, so enter them exactly as shown in the official announcement. Include any special characters, dashes, or spaces exactly. Copy-paste from trusted sources when possible to avoid typos. If a code fails to redeem, double-check capitalization and ensure the code has not expired. New players should redeem starter codes within their first session for maximum benefit.

Bookmark this wiki page and check it daily for new active codes. The wiki team verifies all codes within 5-15 minutes of release and removes expired codes automatically. Save the codes you want to redeem in a note before entering them, especially for codes with complex characters. The wiki provides reward details for each code so you know what to expect before redeeming.
category_qt_community: Join the official Discord server first to access verified information directly from the developers and experienced players. The official Discord has dedicated channels for codes, trading, and strategy discussion with active moderation to prevent scams. Look for verified roles that indicate trusted community members. Discord provides the fastest response times for trading negotiations and strategy questions, making it the most efficient community platform for active players seeking immediate assistance.

Subscribe to top YouTube creators who regularly publish Build a Base and Steal content to stay updated on meta shifts and learn advanced techniques through visual demonstrations. Look for creators with consistent upload schedules and high engagement. YouTube tutorials are particularly valuable for learning complex mechanics like base building and raid coordination that are difficult to explain in text format. Save important videos to playlists for reference when you need to revisit specific strategies.

Use the trading hub etiquette guide to avoid scams and build a positive reputation. Always verify trade values using current community tier lists before completing high-value trades. Start with smaller trades to establish trust with new trading partners. Keep records of all trades for tax purposes and to track your collection growth. Report scammers to community moderators to protect other players from falling victim to similar schemes.

Follow community events and tournaments for exclusive rewards and recognition. Many community-organized events offer prizes, badges, and special titles that showcase your accomplishments. Participating in events also provides networking opportunities with skilled players who can mentor you. Even casual participation in community events helps build your reputation and makes future trading negotiations easier as other players recognize your name.

category_qt_gear: Always carry backup gear sets for different raid scenarios. A stealth build with detection avoidance tools works best against well-defended bases with alarm systems, while a brute force build with high-damage weapons is better against simple wall layouts. Switch loadouts based on your target's base design to maximize raid success rates. Keep healing potions and shield items in reserve for emergency situations during long raids. Having the right gear for each situation can be the difference between a successful raid and a wasted attempt.

Craft gear progressively rather than rushing to the highest tier immediately. Each tier provides meaningful improvements that help you progress through current content, so spending resources on lower-tier gear first is often more efficient than saving for end-game items. Common and Rare tier gear is sufficient for most early and mid-game content. Save crafting materials for Epic and Legendary tier items as you approach end-game content where the stat improvements become more impactful.

Join gear-focused community channels to find trading partners for specific items you need. Many players have duplicate gear or items that don't fit their build and are willing to trade for items they actually need. The trading economy allows you to acquire high-tier gear without spending Robux on the in-game shop. Use community tier lists to evaluate trade values and avoid being scammed. Building a positive trading reputation takes time but pays off with better long-term access to gear.

Test gear in low-stakes scenarios before committing to expensive builds in important raids. Practice with new gear combinations in casual raids against your own secondary base or against less-defended targets. Understanding how gear interactions work together helps you optimize your build for specific situations. Read community guides and watch YouTube tutorials to learn optimal gear combinations before investing resources in items that might not fit your playstyle.

category_qt_raiding: Always scout a target base before committing to a raid. Look for weak points in the wall layout, trap locations, and pet vault placement. Many experienced players share base design patterns that you can learn to exploit during raids. Spend a few minutes observing the target base rather than rushing in, as preparation dramatically increases your success rate. Identify the most valuable pet in the base and plan your route to reach it efficiently while avoiding the heaviest defenses.

Carry backup gear and consumables in case your first attempt fails. Healing potions, shield items, and emergency escape tools can save a raid that goes wrong. Test your gear loadout in practice scenarios before attempting high-stakes raids against experienced defenders. Have a backup plan for each phase of the raid, including contingencies for when traps trigger or alarms go off. Practice different raid styles (stealth, brute force, coordinated) to develop versatility for various base designs.

Join a raiding community or Discord channel to find experienced partners for coordinated group raids. Group raids unlock harder targets with better rewards and provide backup when your raid goes wrong. Many experienced raiders are willing to mentor newer players who show dedication and skill. Coordinate your team composition to cover each role: breachers, scouts, extractors, and lookouts. Practice team coordination in casual raids before attempting high-stakes group content together.

Track your raid performance statistics to identify areas for improvement. Record success rates, common failure points, average loot values, and time per raid. This data helps you optimize your strategy and focus on skills that need development. Many players use spreadsheets or community tools to track raid records. Review your failed raids to identify mistakes you can avoid in future attempts. Continuous improvement based on data analysis separates casual raiders from elite performers who consistently extract high-value loot from difficult targets.
category_qt_strategies: Start with one advanced strategy and master it before adding more to your toolkit. Trying to implement multiple complex strategies simultaneously often leads to confused execution and mediocre results. Focus on the strategy that addresses your biggest current weakness, whether that is base defense, raiding efficiency, or pet collection optimization. Master one strategy completely before moving to the next, as skills often transfer between strategies and make learning subsequent ones easier than trying to learn everything at once.

Document your strategy implementation in detail so you can analyze what works and what needs improvement. Keep notes on key decisions, outcomes, and adjustments you made during gameplay. Review your strategy execution regularly to identify patterns and optimization opportunities. Many top players use spreadsheets or notebooks to track strategy effectiveness across different scenarios. Data-driven strategy refinement separates good players from great players who consistently achieve top results through continuous improvement based on their own performance data.

Study top players through community streams, YouTube videos, and replay analysis to learn advanced techniques. Watching expert players execute strategies in real-time provides insights that written guides cannot capture. Pay attention to decision-making processes, adaptation moments, and recovery from mistakes. Top players often share their thought processes during gameplay, which helps you understand the strategic thinking behind their actions. Combine lessons from multiple expert sources to develop your own unique strategic approach.

Practice strategies in low-stakes scenarios before applying them in important situations. Test new approaches in casual content or against less-defended targets to refine your execution. Many strategies require muscle memory and timing that only develop through repeated practice. Start with easier variations of complex strategies and gradually increase difficulty as your skills improve. Patience during the learning phase prevents costly mistakes when you apply strategies in high-stakes content where failures have significant consequences.
